art_direction.design_rationale: Clean, professional reference card for quick CRM lookup. High contrast for readability, grid background for structured feel.

components.markdown_content:
## KEYBOARD SHORTCUTS

**Ctrl+K** — Quick search contacts
**Ctrl+N** — New contact entry
**Ctrl+D** — Create new deal
**Ctrl+A** — Log activity
**Ctrl+/** — Show all shortcuts

---

## PIPELINE STAGES

🔵 **LEAD** — Initial inquiry captured
🟡 **QUALIFIED** — Needs verified (BANT)
🟠 **PROPOSAL** — Quote sent to client
🔴 **NEGOTIATING** — In active discussion
🟢 **WON/LOST** — Deal completed

---

## LEAD SCORING GUIDE

| Score | Status | Action |
|-------|--------|--------|
| 0-20 | ❄️ Cold | Nurture campaign |
| 21-40 | 🌤️ Warm | Follow up weekly |
| 41-60 | 🔥 Hot | Priority contact |
| 61-80 | ⚡ Very Hot | Fast-track close |
| 81-100 | 🎯 Ready | Close now! |

---

## KPI TARGETS

- Win Rate: **≥25%**
- Response Time: **<4 hours**
- Sales Cycle: **<45 days**
